{{Quote|They have overrun the base! We need reinforcements!|[[685]]'s last words during the skirmish|<ref name="Trespass" />}}
A '''skirmish''' broke out on [[Orto Plutonia]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. [[Battle droid]]s stationed at a hidden [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[Separatist outpost (Orto Plutonia)|base]] on the [[planet]], which was erroneously believed to be uninhabited, provoked a village of the native [[Talz]]. The garrison of [[Glid Station]], a [[Galactic Republic]] military outpost built on Orto Plutonia at the behest of the [[Pantoran|inhabitants]] of the [[moon]] [[Pantora]], was caught in the middle. The Talz wiped out the [[droid]]s and [[clone trooper]]s, leaving the droid heads and clone [[helmet]]s on spears at the two bases as a warning against return.<ref name="Trespass" />

After contact was lost with Glid Station, [[Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]], accompanied by their clone forces and Pantoran dignitaries [[Chairman]] [[Chi Cho]] and [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]], visited Orto Plutonia to [[One-Day War|investigate]]. The two Jedi discovered the Talz and learned the story of what had happened from [[chief]]tain [[Thi-Sen]], but Cho sparked a battle between the Talz and his people due to his insistence on claiming Orto Plutonia as sovereign Pantoran territory and refusing to view the Talz as sentient beings. After Cho's subsequent [[death]] in battle, Chuchi was able to negotiate peace between the Pantorans and Talz, agreeing to leave Orto Plutonia to them.<ref name="Trespass" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish on Orto Plutonia first appeared in a [[hologram]] recording in the episode "[[Trespass]]."<ref name="Trespass" />
